notes.title: Weekly Devlog
notes.content:
🎮 [b]Time to Return to the Strategy Arena![/b] 🌟
Another packed week at Slap Games is behind us! This time, we tackled match-related issues, polished visual glitches, and made small but impactful improvements to enhance your experience.
If you're ready, here are the [b]development notes of the week![/b] 💻✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185284/96124cf44a5b231d29f3278ca8ee8059d6701ed1.png[/img]

🚀 [b]Improvements & Fixes[/b]

🔁 [b]Match Start Issues Resolved![/b]
Say goodbye to games not starting even after everyone hits Ready! We've revamped the matchmaking system — now match entries are smoother and more reliable.

🌐 [b]Discovery & Matchmaking Stabilization[/b]
We addressed connection problems like players not seeing each other or one-sided matchups. Thanks to server-side updates, the system is now more robust!

⏳ [b]Placement Timer Visual Bug Fixed[/b]
There used to be overlapping visuals on the placement timer — now it’s clean, clear, and steady.

🎛️ [b]Smooth Opening Animations for UI Panels[/b]
Menus on the top-right no longer pop up abruptly — instead, they slide in with a soft, polished transition.
A small touch, but it feels great!

💬 [b]Powered by Your Feedback![/b]
All these fixes were shaped by your feedback. Every detail you notice is gold to us!
Want to be part of the journey? 👉 https://discord.gg/Zjxk3MRx

[b]Plan your strategy, prepare your army — see you in the next match![/b] ⚔️
— [b]The Slap Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog
notes.content:
🎮 [b]Strategy Enthusiasts, Greetings![/b] 🐾
Another week behind the keyboards here at [b]Slap Games[/b]! We squashed bugs, gave our characters more personality, and made [b]Godstone Tactics[/b] even more solid.
Ready for the latest [b]Dev Notes[/b]? Grab a seat and enjoy the read! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185284/96124cf44a5b231d29f3278ca8ee8059d6701ed1.png[/img]

🌟 [b]New Features & Improvements[/b]

🐺🐱 [b]Character Names Now In-Game![/b]
You can now see character names on the placement screen!
[b]Witch Cat[/b] and [b]Warden Wolf[/b] officially step onto the battlefield with their names in full display.
It’s now easier to tell who’s who! 💥

🛠 [b]ELO Sync & League Update[/b]
Your [b]ELO score[/b] and [b]league rank[/b] (Silver, Gold, etc.) now fully sync with your real ELO on your profile screen.
[b]Match counts[/b] are also tracked correctly — your efforts won’t go unnoticed anymore!

📛 [b]Nickname Glitch Fixed[/b]
The bug where every player had the same name and #code is no more.
Now everyone enters the battlefield with their own [b]unique name and tag![/b]
[b]Katinc, Mucoco, Sallaneyse...[/b] all gone into the annals of history.

🧭 [b]Timer & Turn Fixes[/b]
– Fixed the issue where [b]two timers would run[/b] if a player skipped their turn at the last second.
– [b]Arrows staying frozen[/b] on screen after the placement phase? That’s fixed too.
Now, [b]turns and timers flow smoothly![/b]

🐱 [b]Cat Bug Fixes[/b]
– The cat no longer moves like a rabbit on the same turn!
– The incorrect [b]"Lion" label[/b] in its description is removed.
– Its [b]attack range[/b] is now correctly set to 3 tiles forward.
[b]Meow-mode is back on track![/b] 🐾

💻 [b]Mysterious Number Glitch Being Investigated...[/b]
According to one of our players, pressing [b]"A"[/b] reveals random numbers on the left side of the screen!
We’re actively investigating this mystery — could it be a [b]hidden dev console?[/b] 🤔
[b]More info coming soon![/b]

🎯 [b]We’re Growing With You![/b]
Every bit of feedback helps us [b]perfect Godstone Tactics.[/b]
Spotted a bug or got an idea? Let us know — [b]it’s gold to us![/b]
Want to join in? 👉 https://discord.gg/Zjxk3MRx

[b]Next move is yours — bring your best strategy![/b] 🧠⚔️
[b]– The Slap Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog
notes.content:
🎮 [b]Strategy Warriors, Greetings![/b] 🐾 Another week of [b]blazing keyboards[/b], [b]bug hunting[/b], and [b]fresh upgrades[/b] at [b]Slap Games HQ[/b]! Let’s just say [b]sleep was optional[/b]. 😅 Here’s what’s new in [b]Godstone Tactics[/b]—ready? Let’s dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185284/96124cf44a5b231d29f3278ca8ee8059d6701ed1.png[/img]

🌟 [b]New Features & Improvements[/b]
🏆 [b]ELO System Overhaul![/b]
* Your [b]ELO score will never drop below zero![/b]
* [b]Starting ELO is now 1000[/b], and [b]scores are multiplied by 20[/b] for better balance.
🎮 [b]In-Game Notification Panel Added![/b]
* Someone sent a [b]match invite[/b]? [b]Friend request[/b]?
* All [b]notifications now appear in the top-left corner![/b]
* [b]Click to accept or decline.[/b] 👌
⚙️ [b]Settings Upgraded![/b]
* [b]Toggle animations on/off![/b]
* [b]Screenshake effects are now optional.[/b] [b]Screen shake lovers, we’ve got you covered.[/b] 😌
🔊 [b]New SFX![/b]
* The [b]Squirrel character now has a unique sound when thrown![/b] 🐿️✨ [b]A tiny hero’s farewell![/b]

🛠 [b]Bug Fixes & Technical Tweaks[/b]
🌐 [b]Discovery Mode Stabilized![/b]
* [b]Fixed crashes[/b] when entering Discovery while matchmaking.
* [b]Addressed issues where Discovery wouldn’t work after the first game.[/b] [b]Explore stress-free now![/b]
🐇 [b]Rabbit Targeting Indicator![/b]
* A [b]floating arrow now hovers over rabbits![/b]
* [b]Arrows stay visible until the character is played,[/b] [b]bobbing up and down[/b]—adorably tactical!
🐰 [b]Bunny Death Glitch Fixed![/b]
* There was a bug where a bunny didn’t “[b]say goodbye[/b]” properly… 🙏 [b]Fixed! Now every bunny falls heroically.[/b]
📌 [b]Minor Adjustments & Polish[/b]
* [b]Smoother performance[/b] thanks to code refactoring.
* [b]Visual transition tweaks.[/b]
* [b]Micro-changes to enhance user experience.[/b]

🎯 [b]Growing With Our Community![/b] [b]Your feedback shapes Godstone Tactics![/b] [b]Spotted a bug? Have ideas?[/b] Join us on Discord! 👉 https://discord.gg/Zjxk3MRx
[b]May your strategies be many and your victories plentiful![/b] 🏆 [b]– The Slap Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog
notes.content:
[b]🎮 Tacticians! 🌟 [/b]
Another week down at Slap Games! After days of pixel polishing, mechanic tweaks, and (of course) endless coffee, we’ve added new touches to Godstone Tactics. Let’s see what’s new!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185284/96124cf44a5b231d29f3278ca8ee8059d6701ed1.png[/img]

[b]🌟 New Features[/b]
[b]❄ New Ambience Sounds for Ice Map![/b] – Chilling winds now bring even more atmosphere to the battlefield!
[b] ⚔ Koala’s Attack Update![/b] – Koala can now attack 2 tiles at once and strike in 4 directions! 
[b]🎌 “Your Turn” Banner Added![/b] – No more missing your turn—this banner won’t let you overlook it! [b]🔄 Screen Transition Effects![/b] – Smoother scene shifts with a circular fade-in effect.

[b]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[b]🖥 Dual Monitor Bug Fixed![/b] – Resolved the issue where the mouse cursor would jump to another monitor mid-game. 
[b]🖱 Custom Cursors for Clickables! [/b]– Hover over buttons, fields, or interactables to see tailored cursor changes (even a text cursor for input fields!). 
[b]🎭 Top-Right Panel Icons Polished![/b] – Icons now change color on hover and show a frame on click. (Don’t see the frame? Try clicking again!)
[b] 📜 Log Panel Expanded![/b] – The action log is now wider, reducing visual clipping. 
[b]🪨 Wolf Position Update![/b] – Wolves are now placed on lighter rocks for better tactical positioning. [b]👑 End-Game King Spawn Speed Boosted![/b] – The King now appears 30% faster, making final clashes more intense!


Your feedback fuels Godstone Tactics’ growth! Found a bug? Have a genius idea? 
[b]Join us on Discord! [/b](https://discord.gg/QuBpCKN6)

Keep your strategies sharp! 🏆 
[b]The Slap Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog
notes.content:
[b]🎮 Hey Heroes and Strategists! 🌟[/b]
Starting from this week, we are going to share patch notes (I hope) weekly!
We finished our new week with full of crunch, creativity, and (just a few) caffeine-fueled late nights here at Slap Games! We’ve been hard at work polishing Godstone Tactics, aka. Upcoming your favorite tactics game, and this week’s updates are all about making the game smoother, fairer, and more ALIVE. Let’s break it down!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185284/96124cf44a5b231d29f3278ca8ee8059d6701ed1.png[/img]

[b]🌟 New Features[/b]
Fresh tools for your tactical toolbox…
[b]New Character Joins the Fray:[/b] Meet Witch Cat! Witchy area damage will shake up your squad strategies. Will you recruit them first?
[b]Steam & In-Game Friendship System Added![/b] Team up with friends, send challenges, and flex your tactics together.
[b]Ranked Mode Goes Global![/b] Climb the ladder with ranked system. Prove you’re the ultimate tactician.  
[b]Parallax Effect Added![/b] Watch battlefields come alive with subtle depth. (Yes, we spent hours staring at moving clouds. Worth it.)  
[b]End-Game Screen Unveiled![/b] Celebrate victories (or mourn defeats).  
[b]Turn Transition Indicator![/b] A sleek UI pulse now signals when it’s your turn.  

[b]🛠 Bug Fixes & Polish[/b]
[b]Localization Love:[/b] Fixed wonky language translations across 12+ dialects. 
[b]Server Stability Upgrades[/b] 
[b]Settings Panel Overhaul[/b]
[b]Pixel-Perfect Animations:[/b] Fixed janky animations that dared to disrespect the pixel art gods.  

[b]🎨 UI/UX Improvements[/b]
Because even generals need a clean war room…
[b]Menu Layout Revamp[/b]
[b]Tutorial Tooltips Tweaked:[/b] Guidance is now better, but will be much better coming patchs.  

[b]Slap Games[/b]
Have fun! 🎮
